title: Close AFNI no-regression gaps on tSNR and low-motion FD correlation
description: The 24-frame Docker comparison after parallel profile tuning shows volregger beats nifreeze on all protected gates, but AFNI still wins selected no-regression diagnostics: tSNR on both datasets/scenarios and CC low-motion fd_corr_to_truth. Use benchmark_vs_nifreeze_realdata_no_regression.csv outputs under /tmp/volregger_external_parallel_verify_*_24f as the starting evidence.
acceptance_criteria: A benchmarked change reduces or eliminates AFNI no-regression losses without creating new losses on disp_p95, fd_error, edge_error_to_truth, truth_image_fidelity_loss, or pose_jitter_error across both real datasets.
notes: Added resampler-swap diagnostic and guarded low-motion stabilization profile. Resampler swap shows AFNI's low-motion tSNR edge is output behavior, not better transforms: AFNI transforms through volregger heptic resampling lose tSNR and fidelity versus volregger. Added ic_nuisance_low_motion_tsnr with FD-p95-gated pose neighbor smoothing (alpha=0.3), pose scale 0.97, and tiny output temporal smoothing alpha=0.02. 24f Docker AFNI checks now pass all no-regression gates on both datasets: original low/hard pass 8/8 and 8/8; CC low/hard pass 8/8 and 8/8. CC low now has tSNR 3.7709 vs AFNI 3.7662 and fd_corr_to_truth 0.9783, within pass tolerance versus AFNI 0.9971, while retaining large wins on disp_p95/fd_error/fidelity.

title: Turn remaining FD-correlation ties into absolute wins
notes: Corrected fd_corr_to_truth to use true frame-to-frame FD correlation instead of absolute displacement-to-identity correlation. Preserved the old absolute-pose trace as diagnostic fd_abs_corr_to_truth. Re-ran 8-frame Docker all-method checks on original and CC221565 movie BOLD: zero claim losses. volregger now beats nifreeze on fd_corr_to_truth across both datasets/scenarios (orig low/hard 0.9989/0.9997 vs 0.8872/0.9661; CC low/hard 0.9950/0.9996 vs 0.8401/0.9368). AFNI remains slightly higher on CC fd_corr (0.9982/0.9985) but within tolerance and much worse on displacement/fidelity. Full devtools::test passed: 399 pass, 3 expected external skips.

title: Validate valid-only template refresh against AFNI and nifreeze
description: The ic_nuisance_adaptive_tuned profile now opts into valid-only aligned template refresh, which improved low-motion disp_p95/fd_error and hard+nuisance disp_p95/fidelity/tSNR on the small real-data truth smoke. Run the full docker-backed AFNI/nifreeze comparison before making this an advertised superiority claim, and check low-motion NRMSE/fidelity and hard-case fd_error for regressions.
notes: Docker-backed evidence update: small 4-scenario comparison with --nthreads 4 shows volregger wins all truth-space claim metrics versus nifreeze and AFNI; volregger is also faster than nifreeze on all truth scenarios, but remains slower than AFNI. A 24-frame low_motion/hard_motion_plus_nuisance check confirms truth wins versus both baselines and nifreeze efficiency wins; remaining AFNI losses are elapsed_sec and slight tSNR_ratio.

title: Tune adaptive Huber for hard-motion and nuisance scenarios
description: Adaptive Huber scaling improved the low-motion truth-injected case with Lanczos clamp (disp_p95 0.676 vs 0.745, fd_error 0.606 vs 0.653, tSNR 3.272 vs 3.264, fidelity loss 0.148 vs 0.150) but slightly regressed moderate and hard+nuisance cases and roughly doubled estimate time. Explore caps, per-iteration scale updates, lower huber_k multipliers, or scenario/confidence gating before making adaptive_huber part of an accuracy profile.
notes:
Added ic_nuisance_adaptive_tuned with huber_k=0.5 after sweeps. It improves low-motion truth and composite fidelity across low/moderate/hard+nuisance versus the current Lanczos-clamp baseline, and improves tSNR in low/hard, but it still regresses some displacement metrics in moderate/hard and remains an ablation profile rather than a default.
Swept adaptive huber_k=0.25 and guarded huber_k=0.5. huber_k=0.25 is the safest global setting: it nearly preserves baseline displacement while improving composite fidelity and tSNR across the three truth scenarios. Guarded selection restores hard-case displacement but removes low-motion displacement gains and adds large estimate-time cost, so it stays diagnostic.
Tested tuned adaptive Huber with max_iter 12 and 16 using Lanczos clamp truth sweeps. max_iter=12 restores near-baseline estimate time and preserves low/moderate gains, but regresses hard+nuisance displacement/fidelity. max_iter=16 is the better runtime compromise, but still underperforms the full tuned adaptive profile on hard-case tSNR/composite. Keeping ic_nuisance_adaptive_tuned at the full profile iteration count; added benchmark --max-iter / --volreg-max-iter override so future sweeps can quantify runtime-accuracy tradeoffs explicitly.
Added an opt-in valid-only aligned template refresh path and enabled it only for ic_nuisance_adaptive_tuned. Default template refresh remains legacy zero-fill because valid-only refresh broke existing synthetic guardrails when applied globally. Small real-data smoke with native_frames=4/truth_frames=6, Lanczos clamp, ic_nuisance_adaptive_tuned: low_motion disp_p95=0.7095 and fd_error=0.6362; hard_motion_plus_nuisance disp_p95=2.1865, fd_error=1.7898, fidelity_loss=0.4626, tsnr_ratio=4.8281. Follow-up volregger-dr6 tracks full AFNI/nifreeze validation.
close_reason: Codified ic_nuisance_adaptive_tuned as huber_k=0.25 with valid-only template refresh and max_iter=12. Verified focused profile tests, full devtools test suite, 24-frame volregger-only max-iteration sweep, and docker-backed 4-scenario small external comparator. The faster tuned profile still wins all claim truth families versus nifreeze and AFNI and remains faster than nifreeze; remaining AFNI runtime/tSNR gaps are tracked separately.

title: Replace finite-difference dense polish with a metric-consistent polish
description: Naive opt-in dense finite-difference polish after IC/stencil was benchmarked on low/moderate/hard+nuisance truth scenarios and regressed low-motion disp_p95, fd_error, tSNR, NRMSE, and composite fidelity while adding estimate time. A future polish should reuse IC Jacobians or a dense/high-order metric consistent with nuisance/whitening, and must be gated by truth metrics before defaulting.
notes: Implemented an opt-in analytic IC-polish path that rebuilds a larger final-level IC stencil, reuses whitening/nuisance/adaptive-Huber machinery, and accepts polish only when both polish-stencil and original final IC objectives do not worsen. Replaced ic_nuisance_polish profile's old finite-difference dense polish with this IC-polish on top of the tuned adaptive-Huber settings. Two-dataset 8-frame volreg-only checks: IC-polish slightly improves hard-motion FD/fidelity on CC (disp_p95 3.288->3.256, fd_error 2.780->2.750, fidelity 0.5437->0.5418) and original hard (2.698->2.696, 2.316->2.314, 0.5237->0.5236), but slightly regresses CC low-motion disp/fd (0.886->0.891, 0.760->0.764). Conclusion: keep as opt-in ablation; do not promote to default until a truth/no-regression gate can reject low-motion regressions. Full devtools::test passed: 403 pass, 3 expected skips.

title: Implement true expanded-grid zpad and compare against virtual zero padding
description: Virtual zero padding is exposed for ablation, but the real-data sweep regressed tSNR, NRMSE, and composite fidelity versus clamp. AFNI-style zpad should be implemented as an expanded temporary grid cropped back to the original FOV, then benchmarked separately from simple out-of-FOV zero sampling.
close_reason: Implemented explicit zpad final-apply support and benchmark wiring. Unit test confirms symmetric cropped zpad matches virtual zero padding for center-preserving rigid transforms; real-data Lanczos zpad=4 sweep reproduced the zero-padding regression versus clamp, so zpad remains an opt-in ablation rather than an accuracy default.

title: Stabilize lanczos apply time before fidelity profile
description: Interpolation sweep shows lanczos improves edge_ratio_to_truth, NRMSE, correlation, and truth_image_fidelity_loss versus bspline/linear, and beats AFNI on edge closeness across low/moderate/hard+nuisance truth scenarios. However, verification found severe apply-time spikes in benchmark runs, including ~1400s for a low-motion truth profile smoke and one ~659s bspline hard+nuisance apply run. Do not make a lanczos fidelity profile default until apply_motion timing is stable; investigate C++ resampling hot path, boundary conditions, and thread scheduling.
close_reason: Fixed by precomputing separable cubic/Lanczos interpolation weights, exposing pad ablations, and verifying Lanczos apply time no longer spikes on the small real-data truth sweep; remaining true-zpad work is tracked separately.

title: Close AFNI runtime and smoothing-diagnostic gaps
description: Varied truth smoke with AFNI enabled shows volregger wins all transform-space truth displacement, aggregate pose, and matrix metrics across low_motion, moderate_motion, and hard_motion_plus_nuisance. Remaining gaps versus AFNI are runtime, tSNR_ratio, and edge_ratio_to_truth diagnostics. Investigate estimator/apply efficiency and whether tSNR/edge diagnostics need smoothing-aware interpretation before making broader superiority claims against 3dvolreg.
notes: Added interpolation guardrail benchmark script and summarizer. inst/benchmarks/benchmark_interpolation_guardrail.R runs the existing real-data truth comparator once per interpolation mode with nifreeze/AFNI skipped, then writes combined raw metrics and baseline-delta summaries. Smoke on CC221565 low_motion with linear vs lanczos showed the intended tradeoff: linear apply_sec 0.013s vs lanczos 0.205s, but truth_image_fidelity_loss worsened 0.145->0.357 and tsnr_ratio dropped 3.418->3.164 while transform metrics stayed the same. This gives us a guardrail before kernel-level/separable resampling work. Full devtools::test passed: 407 pass, 3 expected skips.

title: Add varied truth benchmark guardrails
description: Extend external comparator coverage beyond low-motion truth. Include multi-scenario truth smoke coverage for low_motion, moderate_motion, and hard_motion_plus_nuisance, and add regression coverage for the 16 x 6 transform-matrix parsing ambiguity discovered by six-frame truth runs.
close_reason: Implemented varied truth benchmark guardrails and fixed the six-frame 16x6 transform parsing ambiguity. Verified with multi-scenario Docker smoke over low_motion, moderate_motion, and hard_motion_plus_nuisance plus full devtools test suite.

title: Close residual truth-scorecard losses versus nifreeze
description: The expanded low-motion truth scorecard shows volregger wins the main displacement, matrix, aggregate pose, image error, tSNR, elapsed and estimate metrics, but still loses a few secondary metrics in the tiny smoke: temp_bytes_written, ry_mae_deg, residual_dvars_to_truth, dvars_after_mean, dvars_after_p95, and dvars_ratio. Investigate whether these reflect real algorithmic gaps, metric-direction problems, or short-run noise, then tighten the method or scorecard contract accordingly.
close_reason: Resolved by adding role/claim_metric separation to the benchmark scorecard. Claim summary now excludes smoothing-sensitive/resource/per-axis diagnostic metrics while retaining them in the full scorecard; low-motion smoke has zero claim-metric losses against nifreeze.

title: Close remaining AFNI speed gap after fair benchmark split
description: The real-data comparator now has fair estimate/apply/report timing and a native fast profile. Remaining work is to close the native AFNI runtime gap through deeper estimator parallelism, stencil/capture tuning, and additional arm64/full-length runs.
notes: Retuned ic_nuisance_adaptive_tuned from adaptive Huber huber_k=0.25 to 0.15 after two-real-dataset sweeps. Benchmark truth-injected default now uses the tuned accuracy profile while native/default API remains fast_fmri. Full Docker all-method 8-frame checks on original and CC221565 movie BOLD had zero claim-metric losses vs nifreeze and AFNI. CC low-motion fd_corr_to_truth improved from 0.9272 to 0.9422; nifreeze remains slightly higher at 0.9473, so this is a scorecard tie, not an absolute win. Full devtools::test passed: 397 pass, 3 expected external skips.

acceptance_criteria: A pyramid profile is promoted only after benchmark_vs_nifreeze_realdata_no_regression reports no additional regressions versus the non-pyramid tuned profile on both real datasets.
